subject: ACE enrollment: CloudNova marketplace listing & PDM/PSM pairing
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Kaplan <maya.kaplan@cloudnova.com>; Evan Liu <evan.liu@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: ACE enrollment: CloudNova marketplace listing & PDM/PSM pairing

Hi Maya / Evan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Per our conversation, we’re excited to support CloudNova’s AWS Marketplace listing and co-sell engagement. Two quick asks to get the ACE intake started:

1) I’ve attached a short ACE intake checklist (ace-intake-checklist.pdf) — can you confirm the listed AWS account IDs and primary technical contact?
2) Can we schedule a 30-min handoff between your Marketplace owner and our PDM/PSM team next week? Our goal is to align on listing type (AMI vs. SaaS), deployment model, and early co-sell motions.

Proposed times (PST): Tue 12/08 10:00–10:30, Wed 12/09 14:00–14:30, Thu 12/10 09:00–09:30. Reply with what works or propose another slot.

I’m cc’ing Karthik (PDM) and Aditya (partnerships) so they can join the pairing call. I’ve also included the AWS ACE registration docs below for reference.

Quick note on next steps after we confirm a time: we’ll submit the ACE registration, confirm PDM/PSM pairing, and kick off the Marketplace requirements spreadsheet (see attachment we’ll follow up with).

Thanks —

Sofia Ivanova
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: ace-intake-checklist.pdf (1 page)
From: Maya Kaplan <maya.kaplan@cloudnova.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@cloudnova.com>, procurement@cloudnova.com
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACE enrollment: CloudNova marketplace listing & PDM/PSM pairing

Hi Sofia —

Thanks — appreciate the checklist. We confirmed the primary AWS account (1234-5678-9012) and our marketplace owner is Evan Liu (cc’d). Procurement is looped on this thread.

We can do Wed 12/09 14:00 PST for the intro call. That works for Evan and me.

Two quick items before the call:
- Procurement would like to know if there are any upfront fees for Redwood’s marketplace listing or co-sell enablement (Evan / procurement, please flag if we should collect an RFI).
- Can you share the Marketplace requirements workbook ahead of the call so we can fill in the tech contact and deployment details?

Looking forward to it —

Maya Kaplan
Head of Partnerships | CloudNova
maya.kaplan@cloudnova.com | +1 206-555-0147

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Kaplan <maya.kaplan@cloudnova.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@cloudnova.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:24:00 +0000
Subject: Re: ACE enrollment: CloudNova marketplace listing & PDM/PSM pairing

Hi Maya / Evan —

Thanks — Wed 12/09 14:00 PST is on my calendar. Quick intros: I’m Karthik, Product Director (PDM) for Marketplace integrations at Redwood. I’ll own technical readiness and the listing signals. I’m cc’ing Marissa (PSM) who will run co-sell playbooks and POC support.

Maya — you’ll find a preliminary Marketplace requirements workbook attached (marketplace-requirements.xlsx). If you can populate the infrastructure rows (AMI/SaaS, region support, auth model) ahead of the call it will speed our ACE submission.

On fees: Redwood does not charge an upfront ACE registration fee. Any commercial/partnering terms will be handled as part of the commercial review after we submit the ACE intake. Procurement, feel free to share any procurement templates prior to the call and we’ll loop legal as needed.

Agenda for Wed’s 30-min sync (high level):
- 5m: Intros and roles
- 10m: Listing type & deployment (AMI vs SaaS), required artifacts
- 10m: Co-sell model (PDM/PSM pairing, AWS rep coordination)
- 5m: Next steps / action owners (ACE submit, hubspot deal update)

Looking forward —

Karthik Iyer
Product Director, Marketplace Integrations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0104

Attachment: marketplace-requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Hi all —

Confirmed for Wed 12/09 14:00 PST (I’ll be on the call remotely). Thanks for clarifying on fees — procurement, I’m copying you to gather any standard templates.

One quick ask before the meeting: can Redwood share a skeleton of the listing artifact requirements (screenshots of the AWS console flow or the artifact checklist) so our engineering lead can gather the required artifacts before the call? If you have a public AWS ACE checklist link, that would be great.

Also, HubSpot deal CN-2026-0821 is created (thanks Sofia) — I’ll update with meeting notes after the sync.

Thanks —

Evan Liu
Marketplace Owner | CloudNova
evan.liu@cloudnova.com | +1 206-555-0169
